title: FrontierOR: Benchmarking LLMs' Capacity for Efficient Algorithm Design in Large-Scale Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2605.25246v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for optimization modeling and solver-code generation, yet practical operations research and optimization problems often require a harder capability: designing scalable algorithms that exploit problem structure and outperform direct formulation-and-solve baselines. Existing benchmarks are limited to small or simplified examples far below real-world scale and complexity. We introduce FrontierOR, the first literature-grounded benchmark targeting LLM-generated algorithm efficiency on realistic large-scale optimization problems. FrontierOR includes 180 diverse tasks, each derived from a paper published in a top-tier operations research venue, with standardized instances and a hidden, expert-verified evaluation suite. We evaluate recent LLMs' one-shot algorithm generation and improvements achieved through several self-evolving frameworks. The results show that current models still struggle

translated_title: FrontierOR：基准测试大语言模型在大规模优化中设计高效算法的能力
translated_abstract: 大语言模型越来越多地被用于优化建模和求解器代码生成，然而实际的运筹学与优化问题往往需要一种更难的能力：设计可扩展的算法，利用问题结构并超越直接的“建模-求解”基线方法。现有基准测试仅限于规模和复杂度远低于真实世界的小型或简化示例。我们提出了FrontierOR，这是首个基于文献、针对大语言模型生成算法在现实大规模优化问题上效率的基准测试。FrontierOR包含180个多样化任务，每个任务均源自一篇发表于顶级运筹学期刊的论文，并配有标准化实例以及一个隐藏的、经专家验证的评估套件。我们评估了近期大语言模型的一次性算法生成能力，以及通过多种自我演化框架所取得的改进。结果表明，当前模型仍然难以应对……
tldr: FrontierOR是首个基于顶级运筹学期刊文献构建的大规模优化算法效率基准，包含180个真实任务，评估显示当前大语言模型仍难以设计出超越直接“建模-求解”基线的可扩展算法。
en_tdlr: FrontierOR is the first literature-grounded benchmark of 180 real-world large-scale optimization tasks, revealing that current LLMs still struggle to design scalable algorithms that outperform direct formulation-and-solve baselines.
